name: Veqen
tagline: Scale AI inference without losing track of the bill.
description: See what your AI requests cost and who they were for: a customer, feature, team or project. Ask Cline where spending went, why it changed, which agent runs cost the most and where you could save. Compare model prices before switching, and check recorded costs against your provider bills. Connect your Veqen account to use your own spending data; public price comparisons need no account. Start free with 60,000 tracked calls per month. Authorized users can also set budgets, record bills and credits, update prices, approve month-end records or invite teammates. Confirm changes before applying them. Account roles and plan limits still apply. Budget blocking requires the SDK and is not a guaranteed cap; estimates are separate from invoices. Setup: https://veqen-app.com/docs/mcp. Public prices: https://veqen-app.com/mcp/prices. Start free: https://veqen-app.com/signup?utm_source=cline&utm_medium=directory&utm_campaign=launch-v1

install.notes: Sign in, select your organization, and review consent. For public model prices only, connect to https://veqen-app.com/mcp/prices instead. Never put provider admin keys or personal data into prompts or tags.
